user_query: I'm organizing a charity event and I need to send out donation request letters to various companies. Can you help me find the postal codes for these companies? Additionally, I want to check if any of the companies are using a proxy server to protect their data.

TaskList.description: Collect a list of company names that will receive donation request letters.
Look up the postal codes for the collected company names.
Check if the companies are using a proxy server.
Prepare donation request letters with the postal codes and proxy status.
Send out donation request letters via mail.
